_ownerEmail: Never in this file (public repo). Set at deploy time from the 0600 file <secrets dir>/hadiyah/OWNER_EMAIL by `npm run studio:secrets hadiyah` (README "Owner email").

hostSecrets._why: The split the host gave Sheila Studio, plus the owner's 7 Oct 2026 decision that AI writing, studio email, web research and brand contacts run on the host's personal accounts (README 'Hadiyah: whose account runs what'). Everything else is Hadiyah's own, pasted on Setup.
hostSecrets._hostKeys: Owner decisions 7 Oct 2026: AI writing (OpenRouter), studio email (Resend), web research (Firecrawl) and brand contacts (Hunter) run on the host's personal accounts, from the 0600 files <secrets dir>/hadiyah/<NAME>; used only when Hadiyah has not saved her own on Setup (worker/lib/hostKeys.ts).
hostSecrets._optional: file? = set when the env var or 0600 secret file exists (README Secrets), otherwise a named stop: Google sign-in runs in practice mode until then.
hostSecrets._hf: Realistic motion for photo videos (owner's word 22 Oct 2026): a free Hugging Face token from the 0600 file <secrets dir>/hadiyah/HF_TOKEN; without it the slow zoom is used and Setup shows Connect Hugging Face.

photoPosts._why: Photo posts (shared/photoPosts.ts): one photo becomes a pack of posts that go out on their own with a heads-up and a Skip. On by the host's word, 22 Oct 2026.

whatsNew.title: New in your studio
lines: You can now add photos, not just videos.
One photo becomes a few posts: a short moving video, a photo set and captions.
They post to Facebook, Instagram, TikTok and Pinterest on their own.
You get an email the day before. Tap Skip to stop one.
